visualCompatibility.basis: Three figures (Edit Mode, Show Mode and the Show Mode QuickPlay) were recaptured at this revision, after rows became one line at every width and the QuickPlays defaults changed. The others keep their earlier captures; the panels and controls they show were not changed since. All in the dark theme on an Apple silicon Mac; nothing was captured on Windows.
